resolve_runfiles_path: resolve a runfiles data path using the COMPILER_GYM_RUNFILES environment variable or bazel rules_python
get_site_data_path: get the path to the site data directory for storing persistent benchmark datasets
get_cache_path: get the path to the cache directory for storing downloaded content and cached files
get_transient_cache_path: get the path to the transient cache directory using /dev/shm or falling back to the regular cache
create_user_logs_dir: create a unique timestamped directory for writing logs with a latest symlink
